entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Welcome back. We've been waiting[n]for you.
entries.uk: З поверненням. Ми на тебе чекали.

entries.en: What's going on?
What's up?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Can't you tell?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: It's Valentine's Day.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: The ladies got here just a few moments[n]ago—they came to give you chocolates.
entries.uk: Пані прийшли лише кілька хвилин[n]тому — вони принесли тобі шоколад.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I actually planned to come over by[n]myself, but we ran into each other[n]on the way here.
entries.uk: Я, власне, збиралася прийти[n]сама, але ми перетнулися[n]дорогою.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Once we got to talking, we realized[n]we all had the same plans...
entries.uk: Розговорившись, ми зрозуміли,[n]що в усіх однакові плани...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: That's why we decided to turn this[n]into one big mega-gift!
entries.uk: Тому вирішили зробити з цього[n]один великий мегаподарунок!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I know it might be a bit much, but[n]we figured this would be the most[n]fair way to do it.
entries.uk: Знаю, це, може, трохи забагато, але[n]ми вирішили, що так буде[n]найчесніше.

entries.en: Fair?
What do you mean?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Now everyone gets to make sure you[n]get their gift! It's the best plan for all[n]of us.
entries.uk: Тепер кожна може простежити, щоб ти[n]отримав її подарунок! Це найкращий план[n]для всіх нас.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yep, sure is! We all care about you[n]the same, after all.
entries.uk: Ага, точно! Ти ж нам усім[n]однаково дорогий.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Well, mine was more of a thank-you[n]for everything you did for everyone, so[n]it might not be the EXACT same, but—
entries.uk: Ну, мій — радше подяка за все,[n]що ти зробив для всіх, тож[n]він може бути не ЗОВСІМ таким, але—

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: *chuckle* You know what? That's not[n]what matters right now.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: You sure are one lucky guy.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Make sure you don't leave anyone's[n]gifts out—you have to accept them all!
entries.uk: Дивись, не пропусти нічиїх[n]подарунків — ти мусиш прийняти всі!

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I would... definitely like for you to[n]accept it all.
entries.uk: Я б... дуже хотіла, щоб ти[n]прийняв усе.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Ooh, look at your face! You just can't[n]wait to dive in, can you?
entries.uk: О-о, глянь на себе! Ти просто не можеш[n]дочекатися, щоб накинутися, га?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: There's a ton of chocolate here, so[n]please, enjoy to your heart's content.
entries.uk: Тут сила-силенна шоколаду, тож,[n]будь ласка, смакуй досхочу.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Y'know, you really are one lucky[n]bastard... You all have fun, but don't[n]wreck my café, okay?
entries.uk: Знаєш, ти справді щасливий[n]покидьок... Веселіться, але не[n]розгроміть мені кафе, гаразд?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Perhaps someone should start this off[n]properly?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Allow me—after all, I don't have the[n]same kind of relationship with him[n]as you all do.
entries.uk: Дозвольте мені — зрештою, у мене з ним[n]не такі стосунки,[n]як у вас.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Are you sure? Thanks, Sis.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Although, I admit I'm not exactly[n]experienced in doing something like[n]this, so I won't make any promises...
entries.uk: Хоча, визнаю, у мене не надто[n]багато досвіду в таких справах,[n]тож нічого не обіцяю...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: But I'll give it a shot.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Okay, everyone! Are we ready?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: The chocolates you hold... I suspect[n]you each went through considerable[n]effort preparing them.
entries.uk: Шоколад у ваших руках... Підозрюю,[n]кожна з вас доклала чимало[n]зусиль, готуючи його.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: But it was all for his sake—you secretly[n]got your gifts together all for this[n]special day...
entries.uk: Але все це заради нього — ви нишком[n]зібрали подарунки саме для цього[n]особливого дня...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Am I right, ladies?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I can tell how excited you all are for[n]this! All right, let's get started!
entries.uk: Я бачу, як ви всі цього чекаєте![n]Гаразд, починаймо!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Okay everybody, no pushing, let's keep[n]this civil...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Over here! Over here! Say ahhhh...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Here's some more! No need to be[n]modest today!
How kind of you all.
Thank you so much.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Ooh, look at him gobblin' it up!

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Um... Would you care for some of these[n]as well?
I managed to finish eating[n]everyone's chocolates...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That was quite impressive...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: An amazing sight, indeed...

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: You crushed those, just like I expected!
entries.uk: Ти їх розчавив, як я й очікувала!

entries.en: They were all delicious.
Thank you for the sweets.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'm glad you enjoyed them!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah! And if you liked them that much...
entries.uk: Ага! А якщо тобі так сподобалося...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Then it was definitely worth making[n]seconds!

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: We still have tons more.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: No need to be shy. Dig in.
My stomach is nearing[n]maximum capacity...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Now that I'm thinking about it...[n]Could this possibly not have been[n]the best idea?
entries.uk: Як подумаю...[n]Може, це була не[n]найкраща ідея?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Wha— [fName], is that true!?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Have you actually had your fill[n]of chocolate already?
...I should steel myself[n]and see this to the end.
I have a bottomless stomach.
I could handle a lot more.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Looks like you were all getting worried[n]for nothing.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: This is the best Valentine's Day ever!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Yeah, we're all havin' a great time![n]No complaints here.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: [fName], is something the matter?
